title: Wi-Fi Survey
summary: See the Wi-Fi networks around you and which channels are crowded.
description: Lists the Wi-Fi networks in range sorted by signal, with SSID, signal strength, channel, band and security, and marks the one the deck is connected to. Tap or press Enter on a network for its details (BSSID, vendor, frequency, rate). A second screen charts the number of networks per channel on 2.4 and 5 GHz and highlights the least crowded channel. Passive only: it reads the scan results of NetworkManager (nmcli), needs no root, and never connects, injects or captures anything.
